mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5% in 1 month), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and a rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a weakening housing market and rising cost pressures, which together depress corporate profit margins and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, which leads to higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines over the prior quarter, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits (HOUST) fall below 1600 thousand units in a month, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1600), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% annually), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past three months signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases over the prior three months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
